title: Delegation Without Trust: An Empirical Gap Analysis of Identity, Authorization, and Runtime Governance in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
topic_quote: Autonomous LLM agents increasingly act on a user's behalf: they hold credentials, call tools and services, and spawn sub-agents.
contact_route_quote: Panduranga Sai Varma Dantuluri — Affiliation: VotalAI — Email: sai@votal.ai

relevance_note: Empirical research on multi-agent LLM delegation, identity, authorization and runtime governance.
